en.Italienska halvön: One event has "Italian Peninsula", one "The Italian Peninsula". The text is a place label; the form without the article also reads correctly as a list item and after a preposition the pattern supplies.
en.Judeen: "Judaea" in the Bar Kokhba event, "Judea" in the Seleucid event. The sidecar's own English uses "Judaea" in four events (63 BC, AD 29, 70 and 132) and "Judea" in one, so "Judaea" matches the rest of the text the player reads.
en.Kongoriket: "Kingdom of Kongo" is the name in the culture inventory, "The Kingdom of Kongo" one event's place label. The form without the article is the polity's name and fits a label, a list and a sentence.
en.Romarriket: Seven events have "Roman Empire", four "The Roman Empire". The majority form without the article also fits a label and a list.
en.Tangriket, Kina: One event each. The polity is "Tang Empire" in the court dossier and the map review, so the place label follows that name without the article.
